audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race condition: cache check (line 157) and cache set (subscriber line 42) are not atomic. Multiple concurrent validations for the same (slot, proposer_index, index) tuple can all pass the cache check before any completes and sets the cache, violating the first-sidecar-only invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker broadcasts identical data column to multiple peers simultaneously. During the validation window (KZG proofs, signatures), all peers pass cache check concurrently before any sets the cache, resulting in redundant acceptance and network amplification.
